**Company:** BuildX Interior Products Pvt. Ltd.

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3\-7 YEARS

About the Role

We are looking for a driven and result\-oriented **Sales professional** to join our Pune team and handle business development for **commercial interior projects**.

The ideal candidate should have experience in selling interior solutions, understanding client requirements, developing new business opportunities, and managing the sales process from lead generation to project closure.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new business opportunities through market research, networking, references, and direct client engagement.
* Identify and develop potential clients in the commercial segment, including offices, corporate spaces, retail, hospitality, and other commercial establishments.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, architects, interior designers, consultants, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with the design and project teams to develop suitable interior solutions.
* Prepare and present company profiles, proposals, quotations, and presentations to clients.
* Conduct client meetings, site visits, and project discussions.
* Follow up on leads, proposals, negotiations, and commercial discussions until closure.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth in the Pune market.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution and client communication after order confirmation.
* Maintain regular updates on leads, opportunities, sales pipeline, and client interactions.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and potential business opportunities.
* Ensure timely collection of payments in coordination with the finance team.

Desired Skills

* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of the **commercial interior industry and project sales**.
* Ability to identify and develop new business opportunities.
* Strong client relationship and networking skills.
* Target\-oriented and proactive approach.
* Good knowledge of the Pune commercial market.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with design, estimation, project, and operations teams.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and site visits within Pune and nearby locations.

Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Interior Design, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in **commercial interior sales, furniture, fit\-out, building materials, or related industries** will be preferred.

Key Performance Areas

* Lead generation and new client acquisition
* Sales conversion and revenue generation
* Client relationship management
* Sales pipeline development
* Achievement of assigned targets
* Timely follow\-up and closure of opportunities
* Coordination with internal teams

**Interested candidates with relevant commercial interior sales experience may apply.**

title: Accounts & Purchase Executive
description:
Accounts \& Purchase Executive  
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Accounts \& Purchase Executive to manage the company's day\-to\-day accounting activities and procurement processes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining financial records, processing vendor payments, coordinating purchases, and ensuring smooth communication with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesAccounts Responsibilities

* Maintain accurate records of all financial transactions.
* Prepare and record sales, purchase, payment, receipt, and journal entries.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Reconcile bank statements and company accounts regularly.
* Prepare GST data and coordinate with the CA for statutory compliance.
* Process vendor bills, employee reimbursements, and payments.
* Maintain expense records and monitor budget utilization.
* Generate periodic financial reports and MIS reports.
* Assist in month\-end and year\-end closing activities.

Purchase Responsibilities

* Source materials, products, and services as per project requirements.
* Obtain quotations from multiple vendors and negotiate pricing.
* Prepare and process purchase orders.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding deliveries, payments, and material availability.
* Track procurement schedules and ensure timely material supply to sites.
* Maintain vendor database and evaluate vendor performance.
* Monitor inventory requirements and coordinate with site teams.
* Verify purchase bills against quotations and purchase orders.
* Ensure cost\-effective procurement while maintaining quality standards.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
* Understanding of GST, TDS, and basic taxation.
* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software (Tally preferred).
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 1\-4 years of experience in Accounts, Purchase, or a similar role.

description:
\# Job Description – Telecaller / Telesales Executive

\*\*Location:\*\* Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full\-Time

\*\*Experience:\*\* Fresher / 1–2 Years

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office

\#\# About the Role

We are looking for an energetic and confident \*\*Telecaller / Telesales Executive\*\* to join our team in \*\*Hinjewadi, Pune\*\*.

The primary responsibility will be to \*\*make outbound calls, speak with potential customers, understand their requirements, follow up with leads, and convert interested prospects into customers\*\*.

If you are comfortable speaking with people over the phone, have good communication skills, and are target\-oriented, this role is suitable for you.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# Calling \& Lead Generation

\* Make \*\*outbound calls\*\* to prospective customers from the company's lead database.

\* Make approximately \*\*80–120 calls per day\*\*, depending on lead availability.

\* Introduce the company's products/services clearly and professionally.

\* Understand customer requirements and identify potential opportunities.

\* Explain product/service features, pricing, offers, and benefits.

\* Generate interest and qualify leads.

\#\#\# Follow\-Up \& Conversion

\* Follow up with interested customers through \*\*phone calls and WhatsApp\*\*.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups with leads until conversion or closure.

\* Handle customer questions, objections, and basic concerns.

\* Schedule meetings/demos/callbacks whenever required.

\* Convert qualified leads into customers.

\* Maintain proper records of all calls and follow\-up activities.

\#\#\#

CRM \& Reporting

\* Update every lead and call outcome in the \*\*CRM system\*\*.

\* Maintain accurate information such as:

\* New Lead

\* Connected

\* Not Connected

\* Interested

\* Follow\-up Required

\* Meeting Scheduled

\* Converted

\* Not Interested

\* Maintain daily calling and follow\-up reports.

\* Share daily performance updates with the reporting manager.

\#\# Daily Responsibilities

A typical day may include:

\*\*Morning\*\*

\* Check assigned leads.

\* Review pending follow\-ups.

\* Prioritize high\-potential leads.

\*\*During the Day\*\*

\* Make outbound calls.

\* Speak with prospects.

\* Understand their requirements.

\* Explain the product/service.

\* Handle objections.

\* Schedule meetings or demos.

\* Follow up with previous leads.

\* Update CRM after every interaction.

\*\*End of Day\*\*

\* Complete pending follow\-ups.

\* Update CRM.

\* Prepare daily calling report.

\* Share lead/conversion status with the manager.

\#\# Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

\* Number of calls made.

\* Call connection rate.

\* Qualified leads generated.

\* Follow\-ups completed.

\* Meetings/demos scheduled.

\* Leads converted.

\* Revenue generated.

\* CRM data accuracy.

\* Daily attendance and punctuality.

\#\# Requirements

\* Good \*\*Hindi and English communication skills\*\*.

\* Marathi communication will be an added advantage.

\* Comfortable making a high volume of phone calls.

\* Confident and polite while speaking with customers.

\* Basic computer knowledge.

\* Ability to use WhatsApp and CRM software.

\* Good listening and convincing skills.

\* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.

\* Ability to handle rejection professionally.

\#\#\# Freshers Can Apply

Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are welcome.

Prior experience in \*\*telecalling, telesales, BPO, inside sales, customer support, lead generation, or business development\*\* will be an advantage.

\#\# What We Offer

\* Fixed monthly salary.

\* Performance\-based incentives.

\* Training and product knowledge sessions.

\* Growth opportunities.

\* Friendly working environment.

\* Opportunity to develop sales and communication skills.

\#\# Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

\* Enjoys talking to people.

\* Is comfortable making \*\*100\+ calls when required\*\*.

\* Does not hesitate to follow up repeatedly with interested leads.

\* Can confidently explain products/services.

\* Can handle customer objections.

\* Is motivated by targets and incentives.

\* Can maintain disciplined CRM records.

\* Wants to grow in \*\*Sales / Business Development\*\*.

\#\# Working Location \*\*Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra\*\*

\*\*Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.\*\*

title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions

  

Requirements:
  

* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot
